children: Avalanche Treasury Co. (Nasdaq: AVAT) (“AVAT” or the “Company”), a publicly traded digital asset treasury company focused on the Avalanche ecosystem, announced the appointment of Virginia Gambale to its Board of Directors.

Gambale is an accomplished technology leader, investor and experienced board director with deep expertise spanning financial services, emerging technology and public company governance. She has served on more than 20 public and private company boards and currently serves as Chair of the Board of Nutanix, as well as a director of EVERTEC and Virtu Financial.

"Virginia has unparalleled experience navigating major technology shifts and advising companies through periods of transformation," said Bart Smith, Chief Executive Officer of AVAT. "Her experience helping companies scale in the public markets will be highly valuable as we continue building AVAT and executing on our long-term strategy.”

“I am excited to join the Board of Avalanche Treasury Co. at an important moment in the evolution of digital financial infrastructure,” said Gambale. “Blockchain and tokenization have the potential to fundamentally reshape financial markets, and AVAT’s focus on the Avalanche ecosystem presents a compelling opportunity to help advance institutional adoption. I look forward to working with the Board and management team as AVAT builds a durable public company with the governance and strategic discipline required for long-term success.”

Gambale is Managing Partner of Azimuth Partners LLC, where she advises companies on the adoption of disruptive and emerging technologies, including AI, quantum computing, cloud, data analytics and blockchain. She previously held senior management positions, including CIO and Managing Director roles, at Merrill Lynch, Bankers Trust, Deutsche Bank and Marsh & McLennan. She also served as Head of Deutsche Bank Strategic Ventures and subsequently as a General Partner at Deutsche Bank Capital and ABS Ventures before founding Azimuth Partners in 2003.

In addition to her current public company board roles, Gambale’s prior board service includes JetBlue Airways, Piper Jaffray, Synchronoss Technologies and FD Technologies, among others. She is also an adjunct faculty member and mentor for Columbia University’s Masters in Technology Leadership program and serves on the Board of Trustees of The Juilliard School. Gambale holds a B.S. in Mathematics and Computer Science from the New York Institute of Technology.

AVAT (Avalanche Treasury Co.) is a Nasdaq-listed company that provides investors with exposure to the Avalanche ecosystem as businesses move on-chain. Investors in AVAT hold shares in a publicly listed company whose value is tied to Avalanche, the blockchain technology platform of choice for some of the world's most recognized and trusted institutions. AVAT is designed for those who want access to the blockchain infrastructure that offers flexibility, interoperability, and speed without holding a digital asset directly. For more information, visit
